description: On building scaffolding high above a street, a hand holding a thin brush paints a small red dot on a huge white wall covered with neat rows of round dots in many colours. The view pulls back: a young man in a backwards cap, a white T-shirt, paint-spattered white overalls and a yellow harness steps back from the wall, squints and looks at his work. Little paint pots, brushes, a bucket and a coil of rope lie on the planks, and cyclists and people pass below.

taps.phrase: to paint a tiny red dot
to step back from the wall
